data.narrative:
Wraithwatch is a Seed-stage defense and security company that has raised $8M to date. The valuation analysis draws from a peer universe of 10 comparable companies—2 public (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS) and 8 private firms including UFORCE, Anduril Industries, Helsing, Castelion, and Shield AI, all operating in the same sector at Seed or Series A stage.

Two triangulation methods apply. Stage-progression analysis uses the $8M raised as a proxy for current value and applies a 2.5x step-up multiplier typical of Seed-to-next-stage progression, implying a $20M valuation. Peer-median analysis samples three same-sector, same/adjacent-stage comparables—UFORCE ($1.0B, Seed), Singularity ($400M, Series A), and NODA AI ($125M, Series A)—yielding a median valuation of $400M with a range of $125M to $1.0B.

The triangulated analysis across both methods supports a valuation range of $17M (low) to $460M (high), with a median of $210M. The substantial spread reflects stage and maturity heterogeneity within the peer set, particularly the wide gap between early Seed and Series A valuations. Key uncertainties include Wraithwatch's specific technical differentiation, customer traction relative to comparables, and the timing and structure of its next funding round, which would materially narrow this range.
